# Extension attachment lists expose an inline forwarded message before its nested parts

After the MimeTreeEmitter switch, messages.listAttachments could omit an inline message/rfc822 parent and expose its child attachments at the outer level. The accepted fix treats the forwarded .eml as an attachment and names an unnamed one ForwardedMessage.eml. Its test asserts the parent attachment, distinct sub-message header, getFull/getRaw access, and the three attachments obtained from the sub-message. Current code still returns ForwardedMessage.eml for unnamed message/rfc822 parts, with broader later attachment handling.

Scope: WebExtension MIME attachments.

Paths:

- `mail/components/extensions/ExtensionMessages.sys.mjs`
- `mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/test_ext_messages_attachments.js`
- `mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/messages/nestedMessageInline.eml`
